greeting.title: Your kitchen at a glance
greeting.body: This is your dashboard. It opens on the tab you are most likely to need, and the greeting shows which account is signed in.

cards.title: Tap a card to jump in
cards.body: Each card is a live count: items you are storing, what is expiring or already expired, and what is on your shopping list.

quickActions.title: Quick actions
quickActions.body: Add an item or open the AI assistant without digging through menus.

replay.title: You're all set
replay.body: Each tab is explained once. You can watch any of them again from Settings, Preferences, Replay page tutorials.

header.title: Your conversations
header.body: Open the drawer on the left to switch, archive, or delete conversations. The plus icon starts a new chat.

messages.title: Ask about your kitchen
messages.body: The assistant can see your inventory and shopping list. Ask what to cook tonight, what to use first, or what you still need to buy.

attach.title: Send a photo
attach.body: Tap plus to take or choose a picture. The assistant can read a receipt, a shelf, or your fridge and add what it finds to your inventory.

composer.title: Type your question
composer.body: Write a message and tap send. You can also ask it to add, update, or remove items.

searchBar.title: Find anything fast
searchBar.body: Search by name, or tap Sort to order by expiry, name, storage location, or food type.

filterTabs.title: Filter by storage
filterTabs.body: Switch between everything, the fridge, the freezer, and the pantry. The number on each pill is how many items are in it.

items.title: What needs attention first
items.body: Expired and expiring items are pinned to the top. Long-press any item to find recipes for it, add it to your shopping list, edit it, or delete it.

addButton.title: Add to your inventory
addButton.body: Tap the plus button to log a new item: name, quantity, storage, food type, and expiry date, with tags suggested as you type. You can also ask AI to add the item for you.

editButton.title: Bulk edits
editButton.body: Use Edit in the top right to select several items at once, then move them to the shopping list, find recipes, or delete them.

searchBar.title: Search and sort your list
searchBar.body: Search by name, or sort by when you added an item, its name, or its category.

filterTabs.title: Shop by aisle
filterTabs.body: Categories are inferred from the item name, so the list groups itself as you shop.

items.title: Check things off
items.body: Tap an item to check it off, or tap the three dots to rename it, change the quantity, set a category, or delete it. Checked items unlock Done shopping, which moves them into your fridge.

inputRow.title: Add an item in one line
inputRow.body: Type the name and quantity, then tap the plus button. It lands in the right category automatically.

editButton.title: Edit many at once
editButton.body: Use Edit in the top right to select several items and delete them together. The button on the left selects everything you can see.

categories.title: Everything lives here
categories.body: Account, Plan, Preferences, Privacy, and AI Provider. Tap a section to open its settings.

replay.title: Need this again?
replay.body: Open Preferences, then Replay page tutorials to watch any tab's tour a second time.

welcome.title: Welcome to Pantrio
welcome.body: Track what you own, avoid waste, and plan meals smarter.

organized.title: Your fridge, organized
organized.body: Add items, track expiration, and see what to eat first.

shoppingList.title: Shopping list, organized
shoppingList.body: Move items from shopping → fridge in one tap.

smartTags.title: Smart tags & warnings
smartTags.body: We suggest storage, urgency, and food type so nothing goes bad unnoticed.

createAccount.title: Create your account
createAccount.body: Keep your lists and settings private to this device and account.

onboarding.tip: Tip: You can change settings anytime.
onboarding.aiDisclosure: Pantrio's assistant is an AI system. Its answers are generated automatically, can be wrong, and are not food-safety advice — always check ingredients, allergens, and whether food is safe yourself.
